threejs.name: Three.js 三维
threejs.intro: 基于 WebGL 的 3D 渲染库：场景、相机、光照、材质与自定义着色器。
threejs.intro_en: A WebGL-based 3D rendering library: scenes, cameras, lights, materials and custom shaders.

charts.name: 图表
charts.intro: 折线、柱状、饼图、雷达等常用统计图表及其交互。
charts.intro_en: Everyday statistical charts — line, bar, pie, radar and more — with interaction.

ui.name: 界面组件
ui.intro: 后台常用组件的交互原理：按钮、卡片、弹层、轮播、分页等，画布复现几何与状态，悬停读数 + 中文讲解。
ui.intro_en: How common dashboard components work: buttons, cards, overlays, carousels, pagination and more, redrawn on canvas with live hover readouts and explanations.

css-fx.name: CSS 动画与特效
css-fx.intro: CSS 动效实验室：脉冲/加载/悬停/轮播/玻璃/霓虹等 36 种，画布复现 + 悬停读数 + 公式说明。
css-fx.intro_en: A CSS motion lab: 36 effects — pulse, loaders, hover, carousel, glass, neon — redrawn on canvas with hover readouts and formulas.

canvas.name: Canvas 2D 绘图
canvas.intro: HTML5 Canvas 2D 即时绘制：粒子系统、字符雨、烟花物理与手绘画板。
canvas.intro_en: Immediate-mode HTML5 Canvas 2D: particle systems, character rain, firework physics and a drawing board.

svg.name: SVG 矢量动画
svg.intro: 矢量图形动画原理：stroke-dasharray 描边、路径插值变形、遮罩与渐变，用 Path2D 在画布上逐帧复现，悬停读出路径数值。
svg.intro_en: How vector animation works: stroke-dasharray drawing, path morphing, masks and gradients, replayed frame by frame with Path2D; hover to read path values.

gsap.name: GSAP 动画
gsap.intro: GSAP 核心概念实验室：补间、缓动曲线、Timeline 时间轴、stagger 交错、ScrollTrigger 与 scrub，用自写的补间引擎逐帧复现，并给出对应的 GSAP 写法。
gsap.intro_en: A GSAP concepts lab: tweens, easing curves, Timeline, stagger, ScrollTrigger and scrub, replayed by a hand-written tween engine alongside the matching GSAP code.

webgl.name: WebGL 着色器
webgl.intro: 原生 WebGL 全屏片元着色器：程序化噪声、等离子与光线步进，全部在 GPU 实时计算。
webgl.intro_en: Native WebGL full-screen fragment shaders: procedural noise, plasma and raymarching, all computed live on the GPU.

physics.name: 物理与交互
physics.intro: 物理引擎与指针交互：刚体碰撞、弹簧、单摆、轨道、绳索、软体、沙漏与磁场——每个都能拖动并实时读出能量、周期等物理量。
physics.intro_en: Physics engines and pointer interaction: collisions, springs, pendulums, orbits, ropes, soft bodies, hourglasses and magnets — drag any of them and read energy, period and more in real time.

audio.name: 音频可视化
audio.intro: 13 个音频演示全部基于真实信号计算（合成器模型 + FFT、滤波器响应、节拍检测、音序器），悬停/拖动可读出指针下的频率与分贝，点右上角「声音」即可听到。
audio.intro_en: 13 audio demos built on real signal processing (synth models + FFT, filter responses, beat detection, sequencer). Hover or drag to read frequency and dB under the pointer; tap “Sound” at top-right to listen.

dataviz.name: 数据可视化进阶
dataviz.intro: 19 种进阶图表全部基于真实布局算法（Squarify、力引导、堆叠、四分位、螺线放置…），悬停/拖动即可看到指针下的数值与中文讲解。
dataviz.intro_en: 19 advanced charts built on real layout algorithms (squarify, force-directed, stacking, quartiles, spiral placement…). Hover or drag to see values and explanations.

micro.name: Lottie 与微交互
micro.intro: 细节动效提升体验：关键帧矢量动画（Lottie 原理）、点赞粒子、开关与涟漪反馈，画布逐帧复现并读出动画数值。
micro.intro_en: Small motion details that lift UX: keyframe vector animation (how Lottie works), like particles, toggles and ripple feedback, replayed frame by frame with live values.

layout.name: CSS 布局玩具
layout.intro: Flex / Grid / 容器查询等布局原理：画布按真实布局算法排版，可调间距、列数与对齐，悬停读出尺寸。
layout.intro_en: How Flex, Grid and container queries lay things out: canvas layouts driven by the real algorithms, with adjustable gaps, columns and alignment; hover to read sizes.

filters.name: CSS 滤镜与混合
filters.intro: 滤镜与混合原理：按 W3C 公式逐像素计算模糊、亮度、对比度、色相旋转、双色调、毛玻璃等，拖动对比线查看滤镜前后的颜色。
filters.intro_en: How filters and blending work: blur, brightness, contrast, hue-rotate, duotone, frosted glass and more, computed per pixel from the W3C formulas; drag the split line to compare.

particles-fx.name: 粒子特效
particles-fx.intro: Canvas 粒子套件：星空、雪、烟、引力场等可调参数变体。
particles-fx.intro_en: A Canvas particle kit: starfields, snow, smoke, gravity fields and more, with tunable variants.

generative.name: 生成艺术
generative.intro: 程序化生成图案：噪声场、细胞自动机、递归分形与随机游走。
generative.intro_en: Procedurally generated patterns: noise fields, cellular automata, recursive fractals and random walks.

text-fx.name: 文字特效
text-fx.intro: 打字机、故障、渐变、描边、拆分入场等文字动效，逐字在画布上排版与动画，悬停读出每个字的状态。
text-fx.intro_en: Typewriter, glitch, gradient, outline, split entrances and more — laid out and animated letter by letter on canvas; hover to read each glyph’s state.

scroll-fx.name: 滚动特效
scroll-fx.intro: 虚拟滚动页面里的视差、进度、钉住与揭示效果：页面自动滚动，指针可接管滚动位置，实时读出滚动进度。
scroll-fx.intro_en: Parallax, progress, pinning and reveal effects in a virtual scrolling page; the pointer drives the scroll position and progress is read out live.

math.name: 数学
math.intro: 初中及以上数学可视化：几何、函数、三角、微积分入门、线性代数、离散与概率统计，参数可调。
math.intro_en: Maths visualised from middle school up: geometry, functions, trigonometry, intro calculus, linear algebra, discrete maths and probability, with tunable parameters.

convert.name: 单位换算
convert.intro: 全球主流单位差异可视化：温度、时差、质量、长度、面积体积、进制、速度、压力与能量，参数可调。
convert.intro_en: Visualising differences between the world’s common units: temperature, time zones, mass, length, area/volume, number bases, speed, pressure and energy.

/threejs/solar-system.title: 太阳系轨道
/threejs/solar-system.hint_en: Heliocentric/Spiral Forward · Moons · Zoom to Focus
/threejs/solar-system.desc_en: Shader sun with corona, procedural planets and rings, 30 moons; zoom to focus, and switch to the helical-orbit mode where the sun moves forward.

/threejs/orbit.title: 环绕视角与灯光
/threejs/orbit.hint_en: Drag to Rotate · Scroll to Zoom

/threejs/particles.title: 粒子场
/threejs/particles.hint_en: Move mouse to disturb the particle field
/threejs/particles.desc_en: Points Particle Field Interacting with Mouse.

/threejs/lattice.title: 晶格
/threejs/lattice.desc_en: Place n small cubes along x, y, and z directions using three nested loops i, j, k to form a cubic lattice (like salt crystal structure).

/threejs/torus.title: 环带
/threejs/torus.desc_en: A torus (doughnut) can be viewed as a small circle of radius r rotating around an axis at distance R, sweeping out a surface.

/threejs/nebula.title: 星云球
/threejs/nebula.desc_en: Divide the sphere into N×N segments along meridians and parallels, placing one glowing point at each grid point to create the 'Nebula sphere'.

/threejs/polycubes.title: 多立方
/threejs/polycubes.desc_en: Angle of the i-th cube θᵢ = 2πi/n

/threejs/helix.title: 螺旋柱
/threejs/helix.desc_en: Parameter u goes from 0 to 1, x and z rotate k times around a circle, while y rises uniformly by h.

/threejs/glass.title: 玻璃球
/threejs/glass.desc_en: MeshPhysicalMaterial's transmission (transmission) allows light to pass through the object, ior (refractive index)…

/threejs/wire.title: 线框球
/threejs/wire.desc_en: The regular icosahedron has 20 triangular faces.

/threejs/instanced.title: 批量实例方块
/threejs/instanced.desc_en: Draw hundreds of cubes with a single geometry, storing only position and color per cube — scales well without performance issues.

/threejs/terrain-3.title: 起伏面
/threejs/terrain-3.desc_en: Throw a stone into still water and ripples spread outward from the center, getting weaker with distance.

/threejs/ringcloud.title: 点云环
/threejs/ringcloud.desc_en: Saturn's rings are made of countless ice particles, each orbiting Saturn like a small moon.

/threejs/pillar.title: 光柱
/threejs/pillar.desc_en: CylinderGeometry can have different top and bottom radii, resulting in a frustum (a cone with the tip cut off).

/threejs/mirror-floor.title: 反射地板
/threejs/mirror-floor.desc_en: Reflect the object across the floor and place the copy below the floor, then make the floor semi-transparent to create the illusion of a reflection.

/threejs/knots.title: 环结
/threejs/knots.desc_en: Wind p turns around the major circle and q turns around the tube to get the (p, q) torus knot.

/threejs/orbit-moons.title: 卫星轨道
/threejs/orbit-moons.desc_en: The square of the period is proportional to the cube of the orbital radius (Kepler's Third Law), so T²/r³ is the same for each moon.

/charts/line.title: 折线图
/charts/line.desc_en: Connect data points in sequence to see how values change over time; adjust smoothness and dashed line style.

/charts/area.title: 面积图
/charts/area.desc_en: Area chart = line + filled below, emphasizing cumulative volume rather than just trends.

/charts/stepline.title: 阶梯折线
/charts/stepline.desc_en: Step Line: Values remain constant until the next point, then jump suddenly. Suitable for representing tiers, price changes.

/charts/bar.title: 柱状图
/charts/bar.desc_en: Bar height represents value size, categories along the x-axis.

/charts/hbar.title: 横向柱图
/charts/hbar.desc_en: Rotate bars horizontally so category names are more readable, ideal for rankings.

/charts/stackedbar.title: 堆叠柱图
/charts/stackedbar.desc_en: Multiple components stacked within a single bar, total height is the sum, colors represent individual segments.

/charts/stackedarea.title: 堆叠面积
/charts/stackedarea.desc_en: Multi-layer area overlaps vertically; total height is the sum; color bands indicate individual contributions.

/charts/groupedbar.title: 分组柱图
/charts/groupedbar.desc_en: Side-by-side multiple bars for the same category, directly comparing differences across different series within that category.

/charts/pie.title: 饼图
/charts/pie.desc_en: Circle is divided into segments, angle ∝ proportion

/charts/doughnut.title: 环形图
/charts/doughnut.desc_en: Donut Chart: A pie chart with a hole in the center, where each arc represents a proportion, and the center can display a total value.

/charts/radar.title: 雷达图
/charts/radar.desc_en: Multiple dimensions form a polygon; the fuller the shape, the stronger the overall performance, suitable for capability models.

/charts/polar.title: 极坐标面积
/charts/polar.desc_en: Radius per lobe represents value, angles evenly divided, like a radar 'pie' chart.

/charts/scatter.title: 散点图
/charts/scatter.desc_en: Each point represents a sample (x,y) to show correlation and outliers.

/charts/bubble.title: 气泡图
/charts/bubble.desc_en: Scatter plot with radius representing a third variable; larger bubbles indicate larger values of that dimension.

/charts/mixed.title: 混合图
/charts/mixed.desc_en: Bar chart and line chart on the same plot: bars show quantities, line shows trends.

/charts/sparkline.title: 迷你折线
/charts/sparkline.desc_en: Mini sparkline: a small line chart without axes, placed within tables or cards to show trends at a glance

/charts/gauge.title: 仪表盘
/charts/gauge.desc_en: Gauge: half-circle ring as scale, pointer angle = proportion of current value to maximum value

/charts/waterfall.title: 瀑布图
/charts/waterfall.desc_en: Starting from the initial value, each step adds or subtracts, ending at the final value. Used to break down profit changes.

/charts/combo.title: 组合图
/charts/combo.desc_en: Combo charts combine bars and lines (or areas) in the same coordinate system, ideal for dashboard overviews.

/charts/density.title: 密度柱
/charts/density.desc_en: Many thin bars arranged together, like a histogram, showing distribution density.

/charts/radarfill.title: 雷达对比
/charts/radarfill.desc_en: Stacked Radar showing coverage differences between two sets of ratings.

/charts/doughnutlegend.title: 图例环形
/charts/doughnutlegend.desc_en: Ring + Right Legend, clearer when projecting.

/charts/barline.title: 柱线双轴
/charts/barline.desc_en: Dual Axes: Left axis for bars, right axis for lines. Compare data with different units on the same chart.

/charts/pieexplode.title: 分离饼图
/charts/pieexplode.desc_en: Exploded Pie Chart: Pushes a sector outward along the radius to emphasize a specific category.

/charts/bubblepack.title: 气泡矩阵
/charts/bubblepack.desc_en: Bubble Chart: The area of each bubble represents the value size, and its position represents the other two dimensions.

/charts/sparkbar.title: 迷你柱列
/charts/sparkbar.desc_en: Mini bars embedded in reports provide a more intuitive view of recent fluctuations than numbers.

/charts/areaRange.title: 区间面积
/charts/areaRange.desc_en: The band-shaped region bounded by upper and lower limits, often representing confidence intervals or temperature ranges.

/charts/categoryPie.title: 分类占比
/charts/categoryPie.desc_en: Pie chart preset for category/channel proportion.

/charts/weekday.title: 工作日对比
/charts/weekday.desc_en: Grouped comparison from Monday to Sunday, suitable for viewing weekday/weekend differences.

/charts/kpi.title: KPI 环
/charts/kpi.desc_en: KPI Ring Progress: The filled proportion of the ring = Completion Value ÷ Target Value, with a percentage displayed in the center.

/ui/buttons.title: 按钮
/ui/buttons.desc_en: Button Variants, Sizes, and Disabled State

/ui/input.title: 输入控件
/ui/input.desc_en: Border turns primary color and glows when text box is focused; red border and message appear on validation failure.

/ui/nav.title: 导航样式
/ui/nav.desc_en: Current item highlighted with a smooth sliding indicator (underline or capsule), moving smoothly between items.

/ui/acc.title: 手风琴组件
/ui/acc.desc_en: Accordion: Click title to expand this section with smooth height transition, other sections collapse automatically.

/ui/mod.title: 对话框
/ui/mod.desc_en: Popup: overlays a semi-transparent mask over the page, with a dialog appearing in the center. Closes and returns to the original page after closing.

/ui/car.title: 走马灯组件
/ui/car.desc_en: Carousel: a row of cards arranged horizontally, smoothly transitioning by position, with dots indicating the current page.

/ui/toast.title: 轻提示 Toast
/ui/toast.desc_en: New message slides in from the corner, older messages shift down and fade out, then disappear after a few seconds.

/ui/skel.title: 加载占位
/ui/skel.desc_en: Skeleton Screen: Displays gray blocks to outline content before loading, with a bright line sweeping across to indicate "loading".

/ui/btn.title: 按钮动效
/ui/btn.desc_en: Micro Interaction: Slightly shrink on press, bounce back on release, giving the feeling that the button was pressed.

/ui/switch.title: 开关弹簧
/ui/switch.desc_en: Spring switch: The slider hangs on a spring, overshooting before returning to its position when switching.

/ui/sheet.title: 底栏/浮层
/ui/sheet.desc_en: Bottom drawer: panel slides out from the bottom of the screen and can be adjusted in height by dragging the handle or pulled closed.

/ui/timeline.title: 时间线
/ui/timeline.desc_en: Timeline: Events are arranged vertically in chronological order, with dots and lines indicating sequence relationships.

/ui/tree.title: 树形列表
/ui/tree.desc_en: Tree Navigation: Folders can be expanded or collapsed, and child items are displayed with hierarchical indentation.

/ui/fab.title: 悬浮按钮 FAB
/ui/fab.desc_en: Main button rotates into ×, sub-buttons pop out sequentially (vertical or sector), with staggered delay.

/ui/chip.title: 芯片/标签
/ui/chip.desc_en: Tag: Rounded blocks indicate categories or filters. Click to select or remove.

/ui/table.title: 表格交互
/ui/table.desc_en: Table Interactions: Click header to sort, hover to highlight entire row, fixed table headers for long tables.

/ui/avatar.title: 头像组
/ui/avatar.desc_en: Avatar Stacking: Multiple circular avatars overlap and align in a row; beyond the limit, displays '+N'.

/ui/stepper.title: 步骤条动效
/ui/stepper.desc_en: Checkmark before current step, connection line fills main color with progress, pulse effect on current node outline

/ui/notify.title: 通知中心
/ui/notify.desc_en: Bell shows unread count and shakes lightly; panel lists notifications, new ones insert at the top, others shift down.

/ui/command.title: 命令面板
/ui/command.desc_en: Type keywords character by character, results list filters in real time, highlight items and move up/down, press Enter to execute.

/ui/pagination.title: 分页器
/ui/pagination.desc_en: highlight current page as user scrolls; when page count is large, middle pages collapse into …, always showing first and last pages.

/ui/breadcrumb.title: 面包屑
/ui/breadcrumb.desc_en: Displays the hierarchical path of the current page on the site, with the final level being the current page; new levels slide in from the right, and hovered items have an underline.

/ui/rating.title: 评分星
/ui/rating.desc_en: Hover preview score (stars light up and enlarge sequentially); returns to current score on leave. Supports half stars.

/ui/empty.title: 空状态
/ui/empty.desc_en: When the list has no data, use a gently floating illustration + explanatory text + a call-to-action button to guide the user on what to do next.

/ui/banner.title: 顶栏横幅
/ui/banner.desc_en: Top-page notification bar that slides down from the top; long text can scroll horizontally with a close button on the right.

/css-fx/keyframes.title: 关键帧与渐变文字
/css-fx/keyframes.hint_en: Hover over cards to view transition · glow text
/css-fx/keyframes.desc_en: Loading animation, transition curves comparison, and glow gradient text.

/css-fx/glass.title: 玻璃拟态
/css-fx/glass.hint_en: Drag the slider to adjust blur and transparency
/css-fx/glass.desc_en: Backdrop-filter blurred card with flowing background

/css-fx/tilt.title: 3D 翻转与倾斜卡片
/css-fx/tilt.hint_en: Move Pointer Tilt · Click to Flip

/css-fx/scroll.title: 滚动驱动动画
/css-fx/scroll.desc_en: animation-timeline: view() not supported, falling back to IntersectionObserver.

/css-fx/pulse.title: 脉冲环
/css-fx/pulse.desc_en: Adjustable CSS Pulse Ring with Period, Color, and Size

/css-fx/loader.title: 加载器
/css-fx/loader.desc_en: Pure CSS Loading Animation: Rings, Grid, Bars, etc.

/css-fx/hover.title: 悬停动效
/css-fx/hover.hint_en: Top IDB Could not close temporary folder: %s · Suspend Card

/css-fx/ease.title: 缓动曲线
/css-fx/ease.hint_en: Top Switch Curve · Click to Replay

/css-fx/stagger.title: 交错入场
/css-fx/stagger.desc_en: Staggered Entrance: Child elements appear one after another, each with a small delay relative to the previous one.

/css-fx/parallax.title: 视差
/css-fx/parallax.desc_en: Multiple layers follow pointer at different speeds, closer ones move faster, farther ones slower, simulating CSS parallax.

/css-fx/blend.title: 混合模式
/css-fx/blend.desc_en: Mixed mode: two layers of top and bottom colour by formulae (e.g Fragmented = Up×Down Alternatively, get a new color.

/css-fx/ripple.title: 涟漪
/css-fx/ripple.desc_en: Waves: A circle appears at the click point, expanding in radius and fading out in transparency, simulating water ripples.

/css-fx/accordion.title: 手风琴
/css-fx/accordion.desc_en: Click one section to expand with height transition.

/css-fx/carousel.title: 轮播
/css-fx/carousel.desc_en: Carousel: a set of cards arranged horizontally, smoothly sliding to the next one by time or click.

/css-fx/reveal.title: 揭示
/css-fx/reveal.desc_en: Eraser, Blind, Round diffusion, Diagonal, Pixel block, Fuzzy and clear.

/css-fx/neon.title: 霓虹
/css-fx/neon.desc_en: Neon-like multi-layer shadow simulation using text-shadow / box-shadow

/css-fx/liquid.title: 液态
/css-fx/liquid.desc_en: Blob edge, droplet, wavy bottom; viscous stretch on hover

/css-fx/marquee.title: 跑马灯
/css-fx/marquee.desc_en: Horizontal Text, Double Line, Badge, Vertical

/css-fx/shake.title: 抖动反馈
/css-fx/shake.desc_en: Left-Right, Up-Down, Rotation, Elasticity, Heartbeat, Vibration Bar.

/css-fx/neumorph.title: 新拟态
/css-fx/neumorph.desc_en: raised/indented button effect created with shallow bottom and dual shadows

/css-fx/cursor-fx.title: 自定义光标
/css-fx/cursor-fx.desc_en: custom cursor ring following pointer (or auto-patrol), with trail

/css-fx/text-stroke.title: 文字描边动
/css-fx/text-stroke.desc_en: Text Stroke Along Path (stroke-dashoffset effect), with dashed flow

/css-fx/border-beam.title: 边框光束
/css-fx/border-beam.desc_en: Glow beam rotating along the rounded rectangle border, commonly used for highlighting cards.

/css-fx/spotlight.title: 聚光跟随
/css-fx/spotlight.desc_en: Cast a spotlight following the pointer, illuminating the card below.

/canvas/network.title: 粒子网络
/canvas/network.desc_en: Classic network background with edges connecting particles based on distance.

/canvas/matrix.title: 代码雨
/canvas/matrix.hint_en: Light up character columns under pointer
/canvas/matrix.desc_en: Character rain in The Matrix style

/canvas/fireworks.title: 烟花
/canvas/fireworks.desc_en: particle fireworks with gravity and trail

/canvas/draw.title: 画板
/canvas/draw.hint_en: Drag to Draw · Double-click to Clear
/canvas/draw.desc_en: Exponential Smoothing Brush with Speed-Sensing Line Width

/canvas/orbits.title: 轨道粒子
/canvas/orbits.hint_en: Move pointer-perturbed particles · Watch them return to orbit
/canvas/orbits.desc_en: Particles orbiting according to Kepler's Third Law.

/canvas/trail.title: 指针拖尾
/canvas/trail.hint_en: Move or swing pointer · See trail inertia

/canvas/blob.title: 软体团块
/canvas/blob.hint_en: Push pointer into soft blob and push it · adjust softness
/canvas/blob.desc_en: Soft Blob formed by spring vertices

/canvas/rain.title: 粒子雨
/canvas/rain.hint_en: Pointer is an Umbrella · Adjust Wind Speed to See Rain Line Tilt
/canvas/rain.desc_en: Particle rain under air resistance reaching terminal velocity.

/canvas/wave.title: 波浪
/canvas/wave.hint_en: Pointer near water surface press · adjust wave number
/canvas/wave.desc_en: Water surface from multiple sinusoidal waves

/canvas/noise.title: 噪声场
/canvas/noise.hint_en: Move Pointer to Read Noise Value · Switch Octave

/canvas/flock.title: 群体
/canvas/flock.hint_en: Pointer is Predator · Move into the group to disperse
/canvas/flock.desc_en: Boids: Separation, Alignment, and Cohesion Rules.

/canvas/burst.title: 爆发
/canvas/burst.hint_en: Click any position to burst · switch shape
/canvas/burst.desc_en: Particles burst shaped by velocity field.

/canvas/flow.title: 流场
/canvas/flow.hint_en: Move Pointer to Stir Vortices · Negate Γ to Reverse Rotation
/canvas/flow.desc_en: Vector Field Streamlines Driven by Noise Angle Field

/gsap/elastic.title: 弹性缩放
/gsap/elastic.desc_en: Like a rubber band pulled and released, elements expand past their target size and bounce back and forth before settling.

/gsap/colorflash.title: 颜色闪烁
/gsap/colorflash.desc_en: GSAP can directly animate colors — it breaks them down into red, green, and blue values, smoothly transitioning from the old to the new values.

/gsap/flipcard.title: 翻转牌

/gsap/ring.title: 进度环

/gsap/parallax-g.title: 视差层
/gsap/parallax-g.desc_en: When driving, nearby trees rush backward quickly, while distant mountains move slowly — the brain uses this speed difference to judge distance.

/gsap/grid-stagger.title: 网格交错

/webgl/noise.title: 噪声流体背景
/webgl/noise.desc_en: Fluid background using FBM fractal noise with domain distortion.

/webgl/plasma.title: 等离子
/webgl/plasma.desc_en: A colorful plasma with multiple sine wave overlays.

/webgl/voronoi.title: 泰森多边形 Voronoi
/webgl/voronoi.desc_en: Voronoi coloring: for each pixel, find the nearest seed point and color based on distance, forming cellular patterns.

/webgl/warp.title: 域扭曲
/webgl/warp.desc_en: First push coordinates using noise, then draw stripes/checkerboard patterns on the warped coordinates. The regular patterns become flowing waves.

/webgl/spiral.title: 螺旋
/webgl/spiral.desc_en: Convert pixels to angles θ and radius r, brightness is sin(spiral number · θ − density · r + t), resulting in rotating spiral arms.

/webgl/checker.title: 棋盘扭曲
/webgl/checker.desc_en: Black and white determined by parity of floor(x)+floor(y); apply sin distortion to coordinates, and the grid will ripple like fabric.

/webgl/tunnel.title: 隧道
/webgl/tunnel.desc_en: 用 1/r Depth z、Angle θ As the circle coordinates, z Over time, it's like flying forward in a pipe.

/webgl/ripple.title: 涟漪
/webgl/ripple.desc_en: Each source emits circular waves sin(distance/wavelength − t), getting weaker with distance; multiple sources create interference patterns.

/webgl/stars.title: 星野
/webgl/stars.desc_en: Divide the screen into a grid, placing one star per cell using hash randomization; multiple layers shift at different speeds to create parallax effect, with closer stars appearing larger and moving faster.

/webgl/lava.title: 熔岩
/webgl/lava.desc_en: Several blobs float up and down; each blob contributes a 'field' of r²/d². Areas where the total field exceeds a threshold connect into a single region. Blobs merge when they get close.

/webgl/grid3d.title: 透视网格
/webgl/grid3d.desc_en: Use 1 below the horizon / |y| The depth of vision, which increases over time, allows the grid to roll over to you; above it is a round of suns with stripes.

/webgl/kaleido.title: 万花筒
/webgl/kaleido.desc_en: Take the angle modulo the petal angle, mirror it, and replicate a small sector across the plane to create an n-petal symmetric pattern.

/webgl/hsv.title: HSV 色相旋转
/webgl/hsv.desc_en: Angle = Hue H, distance from center = Saturation S, overall brightness = Brightness V

/webgl/scan.title: 扫描线
/webgl/scan.desc_en: A bright strip sweeps from bottom to top, leaving an exponentially decaying afterglow behind; the background is a grid of evenly spaced scan lines.

/webgl/metaball.title: 双融球
/webgl/metaball.desc_en: Every ball produces 1/d In the field, the sum of the field is greater than the threshold, even if it is "the inner sphere of the sphere", so the borders are smoothly linked when the ball approaches.

/webgl/fog.title: 体积雾
/webgl/fog.desc_en: Multi-layer noise moves at different speeds along the wind direction and stacks, becoming denser downward; a flashlight-like beam illuminates the fog at the pointer position.

/webgl/stripes.title: 流光条纹
/webgl/stripes.desc_en: Rotate coordinates to align with stripe direction, slice by width into strips, each strip selects one of n colors in sequence; stripes near the pointer bend.

/webgl/circle-sdf.title: SDF 距离场圆
/webgl/circle-sdf.desc_en: Each pixel records the distance to the circle boundary, negative inside, positive outside.

/webgl/water.title: 水面
/webgl/water.desc_en: A surface formed by superimposed sine waves of different directions and frequencies; bright scintillation spots appear at peak height regions; adjust phase with the pointer.

/webgl/crt.title: CRT 老电视
/webgl/crt.desc_en: Quantizes the image into pixel blocks, then adds horizontal scan lines, RGB channel misalignment (color distortion), and dark corners at the corners, simulating an old television display.

/webgl/julia-sh.title: Julia 分形
/webgl/julia-sh.desc_en: Every pixel as a complex number z，Repeatedly z = z² + c，After how many steps? |z| Surpass 2（Run away.

/webgl/snow-sh.title: 飘雪
/webgl/snow-sh.desc_en: Each layer divides the screen into a grid, placing a randomly offset snowflake in each cell and moving it downward; closer layers are larger and move faster, with wind causing snowflakes to tilt and drift.

/webgl/oil.title: 油画噪声
/webgl/oil.desc_en: Coordinates are iteratively rotated and noise-shifted, with each iteration making the pattern more complex, resembling oil paint flowing on water; rainbow filter simulates interference colors in soap bubbles.

/physics/matter.title: Matter.js 物理引擎
/physics/matter.hint_en: Press and throw object · Push object with pointer
/physics/matter.desc_en: Realistic rigid body engine: gravity, impulse collisions, elasticity, and friction.

/physics/drag.title: 拖拽排序
/physics/drag.hint_en: Drag Card to Another Column · Spring Return
/physics/drag.desc_en: Drag-and-sort board with critical damping spring animation for card return.

/physics/magnetic.title: 磁吸与光标跟随
/physics/magnetic.hint_en: Move cursor toward button · Click pulse
/physics/magnetic.desc_en: Magnetic attraction button (distance decay) + Spring follow cursor with trail.

/physics/wall-ball.title: 弹球墙
/physics/wall-ball.hint_en: Pick up a ball and swing it out · pointer acts as a barrier
/physics/wall-ball.desc_en: Bouncing with gravity and restitution coefficient, with momentum conservation between balls

/physics/multigrav.title: 多重力
/physics/multigrav.hint_en: pointer is a gravity well · make G negative to become repulsive
/physics/multigrav.desc_en: 500 particles in multiple softened square gravitational wells.

/physics/spring.title: 弹簧链
/physics/spring.desc_en: Hooke's Law spring mass chain, observe period and energy.

/physics/box-collide.title: 碰撞盒
/physics/box-collide.hint_en: Pick up a box and throw it · Push box with pointer
/physics/box-collide.desc_en: AABB collision detection + impulse and friction, boxes can stack.

/physics/bubbles.title: 漂浮气泡
/physics/bubbles.desc_en: Stokes' Law: Larger bubbles rise faster (r²).

/physics/pendulum.title: 摆锤
/physics/pendulum.hint_en: Drag the bob to any angle and release
/physics/pendulum.desc_en: RK4 Non-linear monopolistic blocker + resonance drive.

/physics/hourglass.title: 沙漏粒子
/physics/hourglass.hint_en: click to flip · drag to dig sand
/physics/hourglass.desc_en: particle cellular automaton hourglass with flow following Beverloo's law

/physics/magnet.title: 磁力点
/physics/magnet.hint_en: Move the Needle (also a Magnetic Pole) to See Needle Orientation
/physics/magnet.desc_en: Magnet Array Displays Superimposed Fields and Field Lines of Multiple Poles

/physics/rope.title: 弹性绳
/physics/rope.hint_en: Drag the rope · push the pointer away

/physics/billiard.title: 台球
/physics/billiard.hint_en: Drag the white ball backward to aim · release to strike
/physics/billiard.desc_en: Wait for mass elastic collisions and rolling frictions to stop distance v²/2μg。

/physics/orbit-p.title: 轨道物理
/physics/orbit-p.desc_en: Kepler's orbit using Verlet symplectic integration.

/physics/softbody.title: 软体感
/physics/softbody.hint_en: Pull and stretch edges · throw outward
/physics/softbody.desc_en: Jello-like soft body with spring masses and internal gas pressure.

/audio/synth.title: 合成器

/audio/mic.title: 麦克风可视化
/audio/mic.hint_en: Click top-right to authorize microphone · Demonstrates voice model without microphone
/audio/mic.desc_en: Spectrogram + Vowel Formants: Real-time breaks microphone sound into frequencies.

/audio/bars.title: 柱状频谱
/audio/bars.hint_en: Hover to see frequency and decibel · Turn on sound in top-right
/audio/bars.desc_en: Real FFT: Breaks music into frequency bars with peak hold and log frequency axis.

/audio/circle-wave.title: 圆形波形
/audio/circle-wave.hint_en: Hover to see phase and amplitude
/audio/circle-wave.desc_en: Wrap the time-domain waveform into a circle: radius = base + amplitude

/audio/eq.hint_en: Drag band dots to adjust gain · Hover to see response

/audio/part-audio.desc_en: Drive particle count, speed, and color using energy from low, mid, and high frequency bands.

/audio/polar.hint_en: Hover to see frequency at that angle

/audio/waterfall.hint_en: Hover to see energy at a specific moment and frequency

/audio/chord.desc_en: Constituent notes, frequency ratios, and synthesized waveforms of major and minor chords, automatically cycling through C–G–Am–F

/audio/noise-pad.title: 噪声滤波垫
/audio/noise-pad.hint_en: Drag: left/right to adjust cutoff frequency, up/down to adjust resonance
/audio/noise-pad.desc_en: White/pink/brown noise passed through low-pass/band-pass/high-pass filters, observe how the spectrum is sculpted.

/dataviz/graph.desc_en: Technology stack relationship network: Coulomb repulsion + spring tension in force-directed layout

/dataviz/treemap.hint_en: Hover to see value · Click to drill down / go back

/dataviz/d3-force.title: 力导向图
/dataviz/d3-force.desc_en: Force-directed simulation for group clustering: charge, link, and collision forces with temperature cooling.

/dataviz/heatmap.title: 热力图
/dataviz/heatmap.hint_en: Hover over a cell to see row and column values
/dataviz/heatmap.desc_en: Grid data from Gaussian hotspot overlay, γ contrast with cool-warm color palette.

/dataviz/radar.title: 雷达图
/dataviz/radar.hint_en: Rotate the pointer around the center to view each dimension sequentially
/dataviz/radar.desc_en: Multi-series, multi-dimensional comparison with real-time polygon area calculation

/dataviz/sankey.title: 桑基图
/dataviz/sankey.hint_en: Hover over flow bands to see traffic distribution
/dataviz/sankey.desc_en: Source → Page → Flow chart to go, intermediate node in = Out.

/dataviz/bubbles.title: 气泡散点
/dataviz/bubbles.desc_en: Scatter plot with bubble size representing 3D data, real-time Pearson r and regression line.

/dataviz/cal-heat.title: 日历热力
/dataviz/cal-heat.desc_en: GitHub-style calendar heatmap: graded coloring, active days, and longest streaks

/dataviz/sunburst.title: 旭日图
/dataviz/sunburst.hint_en: Hover sector · Click to drill down
/dataviz/sunburst.desc_en: Layered hierarchy with proportional share per ring, sector angle ∝ value

/dataviz/chord.title: 和弦图
/dataviz/chord.hint_en: Rotate around outer ring to view groups
/dataviz/chord.desc_en: City flow matrix: arc length ∝ outflow, chord width ∝ bidirectional flow

/dataviz/boxplot.title: 箱线图
/dataviz/boxplot.desc_en: Q1 in real time / Median / Q3, 1.5 · IQR muster with an off-group point.

/dataviz/parallel.title: 平行坐标
/dataviz/parallel.hint_en: Move Pointer on Axis to Select Range
/dataviz/parallel.desc_en: Multi-dimensional data fold + pointer filter, counting selected bars.

/dataviz/stream.title: 流图
/dataviz/stream.desc_en: Stacked area chart with time scrolling, comparing three baseline modes.

/dataviz/wordcloud.title: 词云
/dataviz/wordcloud.hint_en: Hover word to see frequency size
/dataviz/wordcloud.desc_en: Zipf frequency + Archimedean spiral to prevent overlap, with linear/√/log size mapping.

/dataviz/hierarchy.title: 层级列表
/dataviz/hierarchy.desc_en: A collapsible indentation tree with value tracks showing the proportion of the whole.

/dataviz/funnel.title: 转化漏斗
/dataviz/funnel.desc_en: Multi-stage conversion from visit to recommendation: cumulative conversion = product of step-by-step conversion rates.

/dataviz/candle.title: K 线图（蜡烛图）
/dataviz/candle.hint_en: Hover to see Open, High, Low, Close
/dataviz/candle.desc_en: Log-normal random walk market, real-time jumps + moving average + volume.

/dataviz/icicle.title: 冰柱图
/dataviz/icicle.hint_en: Hover · Click a block to drill down
/dataviz/icicle.desc_en: Rectangular hierarchical partition, child blocks below parent and sized by value

/dataviz/arc.title: 弧形进度
/dataviz/arc.desc_en: multi-layer KPI rings, with linear/ease-out/elastic easing animations

/micro/lottie.title: Lottie 动画
/micro/lottie.desc_en: Lottie principle: interpolates position, scale, and rotation of each layer at keyframe times.

/micro/like.title: 点赞与反馈
/micro/like.desc_en: Particle burst on like, collection, and count scroll.

/micro/controls.title: 开关与涟漪
/micro/controls.desc_en: Toggle, Checkbox Placement 425 cancel, Material thallium with load button.

/micro/heart.title: 心跳赞
/micro/heart.desc_en: Liked hearts pulse rhythmically — quickly zooming in and back out, like a 'thump'.

/micro/check.title: 勾选弹跳
/micro/check.desc_en: When clicking a checkbox, the box first shrinks slightly, then bounces back beyond its original size (spring effect), and the checkmark draws along the stroke from left to right, with text adding strikethrough...

/micro/send.title: 发送纸飞机
/micro/send.desc_en: After clicking 'Send', the paper plane icon inside the button flies out along a quadratic Bézier curve and leaves a trail. The button text changes to 'Sent ✓', then gradually recovers...

/micro/copy.title: 复制成功
/micro/copy.desc_en: Click the copy button in the top-right corner of the code block. The code will be highlighted once (indicating selection), the button icon changes from 'two pages' to 'checkmark', and a toast appears at the bottom...

/micro/download.title: 下载进度
/micro/download.desc_en: A progress bar per document, from 0% to 100%.

/micro/skeleton.title: 骨架屏
/micro/skeleton.desc_en: While data is loading, draw a gray circle and bar to outline the page, then have a highlight sweep from left to right to indicate 'loading'.

/micro/toast.title: 轻提示 Toast
/micro/toast.desc_en: A short notification appears at the bottom of the screen after an action, fades away automatically after a few seconds, and does not interrupt the user.

/micro/badge.title: 徽章跳动
/micro/badge.desc_en: a red dot in the top-right corner of the icon shows the unread count.

/micro/drag.title: 拖动卡片
/micro/drag.desc_en: Hold a card to drag it. The card slightly enlarges, darkens, and tilts in the direction of movement. When released, it bounces back to its original position like being pulled by a spring.

/micro/longpress.title: 长按确认
/micro/longpress.desc_en: Dangerous operations (like deletion) should not be accidentally triggered, so a hold time is required.

/micro/shake.title: 摇一摇提示
/micro/shake.desc_en: When the password is incorrect, the input box will rapidly shake left and right, turn red, and display an error message below.

/micro/slide-verify.title: 滑动验证
/micro/slide-verify.desc_en: There is a puzzle-shaped gap on the image. The user drags the slider below, and the puzzle piece moves horizontally. When released, if the distance between the puzzle and the gap is less than the tolerance, the verification...

/micro/dblzoom.title: 双击放大
/micro/dblzoom.desc_en: Quickly tap twice on an image to smoothly zoom in centered at the tap location (like a phone photo viewer), then tap again to zoom back out.

/micro/hover-mag.title: 悬停磁吸
/micro/hover-mag.desc_en: When the pointer enters the sensing range around the button, the button shifts slightly toward the pointer, and the text on the button shifts more (creating depth); when leaving, it returns to its original position.

/micro/press-ripple.title: 按压波纹
/micro/press-ripple.desc_en: When clicking the button, draw a circle from the click position. The circle rapidly expands, fades in color, and is clipped within the button's rounded rectangle.

/micro/toggle-spring.title: 开关弹簧
/micro/toggle-spring.desc_en: The switch knob doesn't move smoothly; it overshoots like a spring, bouncing back and forth before settling.

/layout/grid.title: Grid 网格布局
/layout/grid.hint_en: Top toggle · +/− elements · adjust row count/spacing
/layout/grid.desc_en: CSS Grid toy: light gradient cells.

/layout/flex.title: Flex 弹性布局
/layout/flex.desc_en: Flexbox Layout: Child elements align in a row along the main axis, with adjustable alignment, spacing, and wrapping.

/layout/columns.title: 多列排版
/layout/columns.desc_en: A long paragraph automatically splits into N columns, shortening the reading line.

/layout/layers.title: 绝对层叠
/layout/layers.desc_en: The elements are removed from the ordinary flow, using coordinates and z-index to determine who is on top.

/layout/bento.title: Bento 便当拼贴
/layout/bento.desc_en: Bento layout uses the same grid to let certain cards span across multiple columns and rows, creating a clear hierarchy of content, commonly seen in product landing pages and dashboards.

/layout/holy.title: 圣杯布局
/layout/holy.desc_en: One title at the top, footer at the bottom, three columns in the middle.

/layout/aspect.title: 纵横比卡片
/layout/aspect.desc_en: Video covers and card thumbnails need fixed aspect ratio.

/layout/overlap.title: 重叠层叠
/layout/overlap.desc_en: Avatars, stacked notifications, cover misalignment all rely on overlap.

/layout/subgrid.title: 子网格
/layout/subgrid.desc_en: Subgrid lets nested grids 'borrow' parent grid lines, allowing panel content to align with adjacent cards.

/filters/blur.title: 模糊
/filters/blur.desc_en: Replace each pixel with the average of its surrounding pixels, smoothing out image details.

/filters/brightness.title: 亮度
/filters/brightness.desc_en: Multiply red, green, and blue channels by the same number.

/filters/contrast.title: 对比
/filters/contrast.desc_en: The distance from each channel to the centre is multiplied by a multiple, with middle ash (0.5).

/filters/saturate.title: 饱和
/filters/saturate.desc_en: First calculate the 'grayscale' (a uniform shade of gray with the same brightness), then amplify or reduce the difference between the color and this grayscale.

/filters/hue.title: 色相旋转
/filters/hue.desc_en: Rotate each color by the same angle on the hue ring, keeping brightness nearly constant.

/filters/invert.title: 反相
/filters/invert.desc_en: Change every channel to 255 minus it. Black to white, White to black, Red turns green, Leaders, just like old film negatives.

/filters/grayscale.title: 灰度
/filters/grayscale.desc_en: Convert colors to grayscale with equal brightness

/filters/sepia.title: 怀旧褐色
/filters/sepia.desc_en: Simulates a vintage photo yellow-brown effect.

/filters/drop-shadow.title: 投影发光
/filters/drop-shadow.desc_en: Unlike box-shadow, drop-shadow generates shadows along the actual outline of the graphic, including transparent areas, so stars...

/filters/neon-combo.title: 组合霓虹
/filters/neon-combo.desc_en: Neon effect is built from multiple layers of filters — the outermost layer is a broad, semi-transparent colored glow (blurred drop-shadow), followed by...

/filters/glass.title: 毛玻璃
/filters/glass.desc_en: Blur the content behind the card, then overlay a semi-transparent white layer with a bright edge, creating the appearance of viewing through frosted glass.

/filters/duotone.title: 双色调
/filters/duotone.desc_en: Convert the image to grayscale, keeping only the 'light or dark' information; then define two colors — the darkest areas use the dark color (primary), and the lightest areas use the bright color (complementary of the primary…)

/filters/vignette.title: 暗角
/filters/vignette.desc_en: Darkens the edges of the image, drawing attention to the center, commonly used in photography and film.

/filters/glow-edge.title: 发光描边
/filters/glow-edge.desc_en: Draw only the outline of the shape and add a blurred shadow (drop-shadow / text-shadow) to it in the same color — that's how you get...

/filters/backdrop.title: 背板模糊
/filters/backdrop.desc_en: Used in iOS navigation bars and notification centers — content scrolls beneath cards, and the part visible through the card is blurred, showing that there's something underneath...

/particles-fx/starfield.title: 星空
/particles-fx/starfield.desc_en: Each star has a depth z, z decreases over time (approaching you); screen position = center + direction / z; closer stars are larger and faster; Warp Line draws...

/particles-fx/snow.title: 降雪
/particles-fx/snow.desc_en: Snowflakes fall from the top at even speeds and waver around the right and the bottom resurfaces from the top; wind tilts the direction of the drop.

/particles-fx/goldrain.title: 金雨
/particles-fx/goldrain.desc_en: Long golden line segments fall rapidly, splashing small sparks at the bottom; some particles have flashing cross-star effects.

/particles-fx/smoke-col.title: 烟柱
/particles-fx/smoke-col.desc_en: Smoke particles rise from the bottom source, growing larger and more transparent with height, spreading outward according to the diffusion angle; a pointer simulates wind pushing the smoke off course.

/particles-fx/firefly.title: 萤火
/particles-fx/firefly.desc_en: Each firefly moves slowly along two sine curves of different frequencies (Lissajous patterns), with a slowly pulsing brightness; fireflies near the pointer are attracted toward it.

/particles-fx/fountain.title: 火花喷泉
/particles-fx/fountain.desc_en: Each spark is ejected at a random angle and initial velocity, then follows a parabolic trajectory under gravity, fading from bright white to darker colors.

/particles-fx/attractor.title: 引力井
/particles-fx/attractor.desc_en: Each particle orbits the pointer in a circular path; stronger gravity results in smaller orbits and faster rotation (like planets: closer ones rotate faster).

/particles-fx/repulsor.title: 排斥场
/particles-fx/repulsor.desc_en: Particles form a neat grid; particles near the pointer are pushed away with force that decays with distance; after leaving, particles bounce back to their original positions and gently breathe.

/particles-fx/follow-swarm.title: 跟随群
/particles-fx/follow-swarm.desc_en: Each individual follows the pointer with different delays and orbits the target in small circular paths, creating a fish-like or bee-like swarm effect.

/particles-fx/explode.title: 爆炸碎屑
/particles-fx/explode.desc_en: Three offset explosion points; fragments fly out from the center in random directions, decelerate due to resistance, fall under gravity, and gradually fade out; the first explosion point follows the pointer.

/particles-fx/galaxy.title: 螺旋星系
/particles-fx/galaxy.desc_en: Stars are logarithmically distributed along several arms, rotating faster closer to the center (differential rotation), with a bright central bulge; the pointer tilts the galaxy.

/particles-fx/heartfield.title: 心形场
/particles-fx/heartfield.desc_en: Particles distributed near the heart-shaped curve, scaling overall in rhythm with the heartbeat (rapid expansion, slow contraction); particles are gently pushed when the pointer approaches.

/particles-fx/text-dots.title: 文字点阵
/particles-fx/text-dots.desc_en: Draw the text to the screen canvas, then sample it every few pixels, and put a particle in colour; the particle floats slightly near the target position, the pointer approaches

/particles-fx/grid-pulse.title: 网格跳动
/particles-fx/grid-pulse.desc_en: Circular waves emanate from the pointer position, amplifying and brightening points where the wave peaks pass, like buoys on a water surface.

/particles-fx/wave-part.title: 波浪粒子
/particles-fx/wave-part.desc_en: The particles are lined in multiple rows, each line rises up and down along the sine wave, staggering between the rows into a 3D up and down surface; the wave at the pointer position is higher.

/particles-fx/comet.title: 彗星
/particles-fx/comet.desc_en: Each comet moves diagonally across the sky, with its tail composed of many particles that gradually diminish in size and brightness, tracing the path of its previous position.

/particles-fx/bubbles.title: 泡泡上升
/particles-fx/bubbles.desc_en: Bubbles rise from the bottom, swaying left and right, becoming more transparent as they approach the top; bubbles are pushed away when the pointer touches them.

/particles-fx/leaves.title: 落叶
/particles-fx/leaves.desc_en: Leaves slowly descend while swinging widely left and right and rotating around their own axis; leaf shape is an ellipse made of two arcs.

/particles-fx/dust.title: 沙尘
/particles-fx/dust.desc_en: A narrow beam of light enters from the upper left, illuminating floating dust within the beam while remaining nearly invisible outside the beam; the beam rotates with the pointer.

/particles-fx/neon-dots.title: 霓虹点
/particles-fx/neon-dots.desc_en: Glowing points drift within the scene. A line is drawn between two points when their distance is less than 'Line Distance'; the closer they are, the brighter the line. Hue changes slowly with position.

/particles-fx/quantum.title: 量子抖
/particles-fx/quantum.desc_en: Nucleus at center, electrons move along tilted elliptical orbits; greater electron cloud diffusion means more dispersed 'probability cloud' particles, illustrating quantum uncertainty.

/particles-fx/net.title: 连接网
/particles-fx/net.desc_en: Nodes slowly drift within the viewport, connecting those that are close; the pointer is a special 'hub' that gently attracts nearby nodes and connects them all.

/particles-fx/blackhole.title: 黑洞吸积
/particles-fx/blackhole.desc_en: Particles form a flat accretion disk rotating around the center, spinning faster and hotter closer in (Keplerian motion), with a pure black circular event horizon; the pointer controls the disk...

/particles-fx/rainbow.title: 彩虹喷泉
/particles-fx/rainbow.desc_en: Particles arranged in rainbow arcs across multiple concentric layers; each layer's hue = base hue + layer number × span / total layers; particles flow along arcs, pointer position…

/generative/flowfield.title: Perlin 噪声流场
/generative/flowfield.desc_en: Every point on the screen has a 'wind direction' determined by smooth noise.

/generative/julia.title: Julia 分形集
/generative/julia.desc_en: Julia set: each point repeatedly applies z = z² + c, counts how many steps until it escapes, colors based on step count.

/generative/mandelbrot.title: 曼德博集合
/generative/mandelbrot.desc_en: To every point c，从 z = 0 Start doing it again and again z ← z² + c，Plans are underway.

/generative/gol.title: 康威生命游戏
/generative/gol.desc_en: Life game: each grid looks around 8 A neighbor. Live neighbor 2~3 Just live. That's it 3 One is born.

/generative/voronoi.title: 沃罗诺伊
/generative/voronoi.desc_en: Several "seeds" were scattered, each location on the image belonged to the nearest seed, and the plane was divided into blocks.

/generative/tree.title: 递归树
/generative/tree.desc_en: Draw a branch, then draw shorter branches on both left and right ends, and repeat this process for each new branch — that's recursion.

/generative/sierpinski.title: 谢尔宾斯基三角
/generative/sierpinski.desc_en: Connect a triangle to the middle of the three sides. Dig the middle one 3 Small triangles; repeat each.

/generative/circles.title: 圆形填充
/generative/circles.desc_en: Randomly select a point, calculate its distance to the nearest circle and border, place a new circle there that just fits without overlapping; repeat many times, larger circles occupy positions first, smaller ones fill the gaps.

/generative/terrain.title: 噪声地形
/generative/terrain.desc_en: Treat smooth noise as 'elevation', sample row by row horizontally to draw lines, with distant lines on top and near lines below, and cover behind lines with solid color, forming a layered terrain...

/generative/walk.title: 随机游走
/generative/walk.desc_en: Each walker randomly chooses up, down, left, or right to move one step, like a drunk person walking.

/generative/lsystem.title: L 系统植物
/generative/lsystem.desc_en: Start with string "F" and replace each F with a longer sequence of instructions, repeat several times; then have the 'turtle' draw: F move forward and draw a line...

/generative/interfere.title: 波纹干涉
/generative/interfere.desc_en: Each wave source emits circular ripples.

/generative/diffuse.title: 染色扩散
/generative/diffuse.desc_en: Two "Chemicals" A and B spread and react in cells (A + 2B → 3B), A is constantly being added and B is being removed.

/generative/mosaic.title: 马赛克噪声
/generative/mosaic.desc_en: Divide the image into square tiles, take the noise value at the center of each tile, and quantize it into several color levels based on the 'gradient levels' setting.

/generative/tri.title: 三角剖分
/generative/tri.desc_en: Place vertices on the grid and let each vertex gently jitter with noise; each square is split diagonally into two triangles.

/generative/subdiv.title: 方块细分
/generative/subdiv.desc_en: Cuts a rectangle along the long edge into two pieces and repeats each of them until they reach depth or decide to stop at random.

/generative/contour.title: 等高线
/generative/contour.desc_en: Use the noise value as the height on the map 1/n、2/n… It's like a line on a map.

/generative/inkdrop.title: 墨水滴
/generative/inkdrop.desc_en: A single drop of ink falls into water and spreads outward, with radius growing more slowly over time (approximately ∝ √time), forming concentric color layers. The edges slightly vibrate due to water movement and eventually fade away.

/generative/fiber.title: 光纤束
/generative/fiber.desc_en: A bundle of fibers diverges from a single point at the bottom, each fiber being a quadratic Bézier curve with control points swaying with the wind and attracted to the pointer.

/generative/pixelsort.title: 像素排序感
/generative/pixelsort.desc_en: Scanning the image row by row, reordering consecutive pixels with brightness above the threshold from dark to bright creates a 'stretching' effect.

/generative/cellgrow.title: 细胞增长
/generative/cellgrow.desc_en: Each cell grows up in two, two subcells are separated in a random direction, each in half size (radi Ratified) ÷ √2）。

/generative/gravline.title: 引力绘线
/generative/gravline.desc_en: A horizontal line, like a time grid; on the image 2 The "mass" of a circular motion plus the pointer, each of which pulls itself closer to the point in the vicinity…

/generative/spiral-gen.title: 螺旋采样
/generative/spiral-gen.desc_en: the i-th point is placed at radius √i, angle i × divergence angle

/text-fx/typewriter.title: 打字机
/text-fx/typewriter.desc_en: Text appears one character at a time, followed by a blinking cursor; after completion, a pause occurs before characters are deleted one by one, repeating the cycle.

/text-fx/glitch.title: 故障风文字
/text-fx/glitch.desc_en: Simulated signal interference — cuts text into horizontal strips, randomly shifts them left and right, and misaligns the red and cyan channels.

/text-fx/gradient.title: 渐变扫光
/text-fx/gradient.desc_en: Text filled with a horizontal gradient that continuously shifts to create a flowing effect; overlaid with a white highlight slanting from left to right, simulating metallic reflection.

/text-fx/outline.title: 描边填充
/text-fx/outline.desc_en: First draw only the outline of the text (strokeText) and shift it downward and to the right to create a 3D shadow effect; then fill the solid color from left to right into the text...

/text-fx/split-fall.title: 拆分下落
/text-fx/split-fall.desc_en: Split a sentence into individual characters, each falling from above with a slight bounce upon landing; pause before gradually removing them from the screen, repeating.

/text-fx/bounce-in.title: 弹性弹入
/text-fx/bounce-in.desc_en: Each word is zoomed in from 0 to its original size, because "flexible" will go beyond the original size and bounce back several times before stopping, like Jell-O.

/text-fx/blur-clear.title: 模糊清晰
/text-fx/blur-clear.desc_en: Each character starts blurred and faded, then becomes sharp and clear like focus; stays before gradually blurring from left to right.

/text-fx/mirror.title: 镜像翻转
/text-fx/mirror.desc_en: One turn in turn per word horizontal axis (vertical scaling from 1 →1 →1) and one upside down below Here, A faded reflection, like standing

/text-fx/wave-text.title: 波浪字
/text-fx/wave-text.desc_en: The top and bottom of each word is a sine wave, followed by a little later than the previous word (phase difference), which is linked to a line of buoys that rise and fall on the water.

/text-fx/perspective.title: 3D 透视
/text-fx/perspective.desc_en: Text written on a plane tilted backward, the plane continuously moving farther away

/text-fx/neon-text.title: 霓虹灯管
/text-fx/neon-text.desc_en: Text outlined with thin lines to simulate a neon tube, with a large area blur (shadowBlur) in the same color to create a glow effect.

/text-fx/scramble.title: 打散重组
/text-fx/scramble.desc_en: All characters fly outward from their positions in random directions and rotate, then return along the same path to reassemble the original text, repeating.

/text-fx/counter.title: 计数滚动
/text-fx/counter.desc_en: Each number is a vertical 0-9 tape, the lowest level continues to scroll when the value increases; when the lower position goes from nine to zero, the upper one follows

/text-fx/decode.title: 密码解码
/text-fx/decode.desc_en: Text initially displays as randomly changing garbled characters, then gradually decodes from left to right into real characters, like a hacker interface in a movie.

/text-fx/ribbon.title: 打印色带
/text-fx/ribbon.desc_en: Simulates a receipt printer — the print head sweeps from left to right across the current row, printing text, then moves up one row after each line is complete.

/text-fx/handwrite.title: 手写进度
/text-fx/handwrite.desc_en: Painting the contours of the word with a dotted line technique -- extending the "real segment" of the dotted line slowly from 0 to the length of the contours, looking like a pen in a pen; every word

/text-fx/karaoke.title: 字幕卡拉OK
/text-fx/karaoke.desc_en: Current line highlights like a progress bar moving from left to right, glowing and shining as it passes; once a line is finished, it moves to the next line, up and down...

/text-fx/vertical.title: 竖排滚动
/text-fx/vertical.desc_en: Classical Chinese texts are arranged vertically from right to left and top to bottom.

/text-fx/pageflip.title: 切页翻转
/text-fx/pageflip.desc_en: Each grid splits into upper and lower halves. When text changes, the upper half flips downward to reveal the new upper half, and the back of the flipped piece shows the new lower half.

/text-fx/liquid.title: 液态变形
/text-fx/liquid.desc_en: First render text onto a hidden canvas,then horizontally slice it into many thin strips,each shifted left and right by a sine wave,creating the appearance of text wobbling in water.

/text-fx/pixel.title: 像素显现
/text-fx/pixel.desc_en: First draw text onto hidden canvas, then sample by grid: cells falling within the character shape become pixel blocks.

/text-fx/smoke.title: 烟雾消散
/text-fx/smoke.desc_en: Text is broken into many small particles.

/text-fx/magnetic.title: 磁吸排列
/text-fx/magnetic.desc_en: Characters float freely in the scene with noise; the pointer acts like a magnet, pulling characters closer to their original positions in the sentence and aligning them as they get nearer.

/text-fx/rainbow.title: 彩虹跳动
/text-fx/rainbow.desc_en: Each character bounces up and down (|sin| curve, like a bouncing ball), with colors flowing along the hue ring. The first character's hue is the primary color, and the entire phrase spans...

/scroll-fx/parallax.title: 视差层
/scroll-fx/parallax.desc_en: Mountains in the distance appear to move slowly, while nearby trees move quickly.

/scroll-fx/progress.title: 进度条
/scroll-fx/progress.desc_en: Progress = scrolled distance ÷ total scrollable distance.

/scroll-fx/pin.title: 章节钉住
/scroll-fx/pin.desc_en: Section titles follow the scroll of content normally. When a section reaches the top of the viewport, it sticks there. The title remains in place until the entire section has scrolled past, then it is pushed away by the next section.

/scroll-fx/reveal.title: 淡入揭示
/scroll-fx/reveal.desc_en: The card is transparent and biased when it's not in sight; when it's in sight from the bottom, progress e from 0 to 1, transparency becomes 1, Bit

/scroll-fx/scale-in.title: 缩放进入
/scroll-fx/scale-in.desc_en: Cards grow larger and brighter as they approach the viewport center, and shrink and dim as they move away from center.

/scroll-fx/h-gallery.title: 横向画廊
/scroll-fx/h-gallery.desc_en: When the page vertically scrolls, convert the scroll progress into a horizontal track displacement (translateX), and the cards move left across the screen.

/scroll-fx/stack.title: 卡片堆叠
/scroll-fx/stack.desc_en: Each card uses position: sticky, pinned slightly lower than the previous one (top = base + i · spacing…)

/scroll-fx/wipe-text.title: 文字擦除
/scroll-fx/wipe-text.desc_en: Each line is first drawn in a dark color, then covered with a linear gradient (bright color → transparent) from left to right.

/scroll-fx/path-draw.title: 路径随滚
/scroll-fx/path-draw.desc_en: A serpentine SVG path spans across the entire page.

/scroll-fx/countup.title: 数字递增
/scroll-fx/countup.desc_en: Statistics, which enter the view, are rolled from 0 to target values, often in the "data flash" area of the official network.

/scroll-fx/bg-shift.title: 背景变色
/scroll-fx/bg-shift.desc_en: The page is divided into segments, each with a specified background color.

/scroll-fx/split-wipe.title: 分屏擦除
/scroll-fx/split-wipe.desc_en: The screen is divided into two halves, with content moving in opposite directions — one upward, one downward (or one left, one right).

/scroll-fx/snap.title: 惯性吸附
/scroll-fx/snap.desc_en: Set scroll-snap-type: y mandatory on the scroll container, and scroll-sn…

/scroll-fx/toc.title: 目录高亮
/scroll-fx/toc.desc_en: The table of contents next to long documents automatically highlights the current section as you scroll.

/scroll-fx/cover.title: 封面揭开
/scroll-fx/cover.desc_en: The page starts with a large cover.

/scroll-fx/timeline.title: 滚动时间线
/scroll-fx/timeline.desc_en: A vertical line spans the page, with each event as a node on the line and a card.

/scroll-fx/lazy-img.title: 图片懒显
/scroll-fx/lazy-img.desc_en: Images on the page initially appear as gray placeholders and only begin downloading when they approach the viewport (distance less than 'Load distance'). After download, they fade in from blurry to clear.

/scroll-fx/stagger-grid.title: 交错网格
/scroll-fx/stagger-grid.desc_en: The cells in the grid do not appear simultaneously, but instead emerge one after another in a 'wavy' wave effect.

/scroll-fx/totop.title: 回顶气泡
/scroll-fx/totop.desc_en: After scrolling past a certain distance, a circular button appears in the bottom-right corner. The progress ring around the button shows how much of the page has been scrolled.

/scroll-fx/story.title: 滚动叙事
/scroll-fx/story.desc_en: One side has a fixed illustration (sticky), the other side has segments of text.

/math/pythagoras.title: 勾股定理
/math/pythagoras.hint_en: a² + b² = c² — Squares on the Sides
/math/pythagoras.desc_en: Dynamic demonstration of the area relationship of squares on the sides of a right triangle.

/math/similar-tri.title: 相似三角形
/math/similar-tri.desc_en: Parallel Transversals Generate Similar Triangles, Ratio Varies with Parameter.

/math/circle-angles.title: 圆心角与圆周角
/math/circle-angles.desc_en: The central angle is twice the inscribed angle subtended by the same arc.

/math/area-volume.title: 棱锥与球
/math/area-volume.desc_en: Volume relationship between sphere and pyramid, layer-by-layer approximation

/math/coord-geo.title: 坐标几何
/math/coord-geo.desc_en: Dynamic illustration of distance, midpoint, and slope between two points in a plane.

/math/conics.title: 圆锥曲线
/math/conics.desc_en: Three conic sections with foci, count switch type.

/math/quadratic.title: 二次函数
/math/quadratic.desc_en: Vertex and discriminant change with parameters.

/math/exp-log.title: 指数与对数
/math/exp-log.desc_en: Exponential/logarithmic curves are symmetric to y = x.

/math/power.title: 幂函数
/math/power.desc_en: Comparison of power functions with different exponents.

/math/piecewise.title: 分段函数
/math/piecewise.desc_en: Define piecewise function and track moving point.

/math/parametric.title: 参数方程
/math/parametric.desc_en: x=cos t, y=sin kt Parametric Curve

/math/polar.title: 极坐标
/math/polar.desc_en: Rose curve on polar coordinate grid

/math/trig-waves.title: 三角函数
/math/trig-waves.hint_en: Unit Circle · sin/cos/tan wave synchronized expansion
/math/trig-waves.desc_en: Projection of rotating point on unit circle gives sin/cos; waveform expands in real time with angle θ; can switch to tan, adjust phase/frequency/amplitude

/math/unit-circle.title: 单位圆与波形
/math/unit-circle.desc_en: Unit circle projection synchronously expands sine and cosine waves.

/math/trig-id.title: 三角恒等式
/math/trig-id.desc_en: Geometric proof of trigonometric identities with the unit circle.

/math/law-sine.title: 正弦定理
/math/law-sine.desc_en: Circumcircle of a triangle and the Law of Sines

/math/limit.title: 极限逼近
/math/limit.desc_en: Show approach from both sides to demonstrate the limit.

/math/taylor.title: 泰勒展开
/math/taylor.desc_en: Increase order to approach the original function.

/math/vectors.title: 向量运算
/math/vectors.hint_en: Addition, subtraction, dot product, cross product

/math/matrix-2d.title: 矩阵变换
/math/matrix-2d.desc_en: Linear transformation of the unit square.

/math/determinant.title: 行列式与面积
/math/determinant.desc_en: Parallelogram spanned by two column vectors.

/math/eigen.title: 特征值特征向量
/math/eigen.desc_en: the eigendirection only scales without rotation

/math/venn.title: 集合韦恩图
/math/venn.desc_en: Intersection and union relationship between two sets

/math/combinatorics.title: 排列组合
/math/combinatorics.desc_en: Highlight and count formula for selection.

/math/sequence.title: 递推数列
/math/sequence.desc_en: Bar chart expansion of recursive sequence

/math/shortest-path.title: 最短路
/math/shortest-path.desc_en: Step-by-step relaxation of shortest path on graph.

/math/modular.title: 模运算
